description: Write one structured bug, missing capability, or data quality report for private human triage. Only submit when the user requests reporting; do not include keys, passwords, transcripts or attachments. For a price problem, add quote: the price, at and source exactly as you received them, and grade, signature and kid from the print when you have it; with a signature the server checks the quote against Verity's published keys, so triage can tell a real Verity print from an altered or foreign one. Returns a durable receipt and duplicate flag, not a promise of a fix. No code or production behavior changes automatically. Status is available with the same account at GET /api/index/v1/feedback/<id>.

category.description: Kind of report: bug, missing_capability or data_quality

observedAt.description: When you saw the problem (ISO-8601 with offset)

quote.description: For a price problem: the price, at and source exactly as received, plus grade, signature and kid when you have them

at.description: The price timestamp exactly as you received it (ISO-8601)

grade.description: Grade from the print, when you have it

kid.description: Signing key identifier from the print, when you have it

price.description: The price exactly as you received it

signature.description: Signature from the print in base64, when you have it

source.description: Where the price came from: a tool, a route, or the print source label

reproduction.description: Steps to reproduce, 1 to 6 short lines

requestId.description: requestId from the response you are reporting, when you have it

surface.description: The tool or API route the report is about

symbol.description: Crypto ticker the report is about, when there is one

name: submit_verity_feedback

requestId.description: Identifier for this MCP call; not a signed price field.

title: Submit Verity Feedback
